candidate: work/B4 (B + tapered leg covers + slim upper arm)
note: Evidence abridged by the author from the critic's full report; verdicts and preference verbatim.
reads_as_reason: The head is a rounded block, the chest and shoulders are stacked boxes with horizontal ledges, and the arms and legs are near-constant-width columns.

G1.evidence: Rounded-square head on a very short neck (P2a 0.1103); flat-topped chest box with shoulder boxes on a horizontal ledge; P3 0.397; back box and heavy block feet add bulk.

G2.evidence: Chest box, pinched dark waist band, pelvis tub do not flow; thigh and shank straight columns (P8a 0.8602, P8b 0.938). Dark bands at elbow, knee, waist are deliberate recesses.

G3.evidence: Matte warm-white shells, graphite bands, graphite hands and ankles, gloss visor, no accent; black hands and back block are heavy.

G4.evidence: Similar corner radii on head, chest, arms, legs, but section squareness varies (chest, shoulder boxes, pack very square; thighs rounded-rectangular; feet flat wedges); S4b 0.5141.

G6.evidence: About twice the references' shoulder width with A-shape arms, no neck, boxy head, columnar legs, long feet. Matches head, hip and knee heights and white-over-graphite. IoU ~0.53-0.56.

pairwise.evidence: Nearly indistinguishable; the candidate has slightly narrower shoulders (P3 0.397 vs 0.418), thigh and pelvis read a little more tapered, a slight knee swell, one fewer ledge, 13/19 vs 12/19 and P9b passes.

top_changes.change: Cut shoulder and upper-arm width, arms closer to the torso, a deltoid that flows into the arm.
Taper thigh to a narrower knee and shank to a narrow ankle with a high calf swell; visible neck; rounded-oval chest and pelvis sections.
Shorten the foot, shrink the back-pack and heel blocks, a narrower, more oval head.

notes: B3 and B4 nearly identical; clay renders low-contrast.
